name: First Contact
description: Two computers, one cable. Make them talk.
brief:
Every network starts with two machines and a wire between them. Drag two PCs onto the canvas, run a cable from one to the other, then give each an address in the same network so they can find each other.

Use 192.168.1.10 and 192.168.1.20 with the mask 255.255.255.0.
hints: Drag a PC from the device palette onto the canvas twice.
Drag from the dot on the edge of one PC to the other to lay a cable.
Select a PC and fill in its IPv4 address and subnet mask, then press Apply.
Open PC-01's terminal and run: ping 192.168.1.20
